lore: Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium

lore: Double vision reshapes the moon's halo into the irises of an angel - radiant in their delicate, celestial beauty. Astigmatic lights sharpen into heavenly blades and you are the martyr to wield them.
icon.value.name: helmet.gold

lore: The storm is a wicked beast, built of buffeting gales and electric agony. But at the very heart of the tempest lies a sanctuary, a blink of respite, where the waves run radiant in every hue.
icon.value.name: wand.multi3

lore: Standing hundreds of metres in the sky, the mist hides the ground far below you. Every step must be taken with caution, or else-
icon.value.name: chestplate.titanium

lore: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.
icon.value.name: relik.thunder3

lore: Tinkerers in the Roughworks often repeatedly augment obsolete parts in search of new innovations and capabilities. Their handiwork, an example of which rests upon your finger, compels you to continue the repetition and break new boundaries.
icon.value.name: ring.thunder2

lore: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.
icon.value.name: relik.water3
majorIds.Chaos Reach: Blood Sorrow spends 20 less points of Blood Pool and inflicts enemies with 0.3 seconds of Bleeding per hit, but no longer grants overhealth.

lore: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.
icon.value.name: bow.earth3
majorIds.Seeking Module: Homing Shots track towards nearby enemies much more aggressively.

lore: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.
icon.value.name: bow.basicGold

lore: Some of the many superstitions floating around the Fruman redwoods surround the reflective stone of this necklace. Those who stare at it claim to see a twisted version of themselves staring back, one that amplifies the deepest shortcomings of the viewers' souls.
icon.value.name: necklace.air2

lore: What's the point of your journey if it all just leads to nothing?
icon.value.name: boots.titanium

lore: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?
icon.value.name: leggings.titanium

majorIds.Pounce: Escape becomes a forward lunge.

lore: Her trial was rigged from the start. She deserved no justice for the things they claimed she did. The prison is her world now, the burden on her soul matched now only by the weight of the iron chain around her neck.
icon.value.name: necklace.fire2

lore: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.
icon.value.name: spear.earth3

lore: Wouldn't it be nice to just let go and let something else take the wheel every now and then?
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium
majorIds.Perfect Recall: Memory Recollection speeds up Chaos Explosion by 0.1s per spell but increases Chaos Explosion's mana bank requirement by 30.

lore: Just another song and dance.
icon.value.name: dagger.water3
majorIds.Incision Elegy: Lacerate becomes a forward-moving projectile, but no longer lunges.

lore: These leggings were forged in honour of a martyr, who, legend has it, fought off a horde of the marauders for two days without food or rest to defend his village.
icon.value.name: leggings.titanium

lore: The carving on this antiquated spear writes: Locedtuh Hahod
icon.value.name: spear.multi3

lore: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.
icon.value.name: wand.basicGold

lore: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.
icon.value.name: bow.fire3

lore: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.
icon.value.name: bow.multi3

lore: The falling sun shall be your demise.
icon.value.name: leggings.pale_titanium
majorIds.Lockdown: Meteor will snap onto a target in range, regardless of aim.

lore: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...
icon.value.name: dagger.thunder3

lore: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.
icon.value.name: relik.fire3
majorIds.Blazing Effigy: Regeneration increases Totem's damage by +14% +6% instead of restoring health.

lore: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.
icon.value.name: relik.thunder3
majorIds.Solar Fracture: Hand of the Shaman gains +2 beams.

lore: "What's yours is mine, and what's mine is yours, so emptying those bloated coffers is of little loss to you, no?"
icon.value.name: chestplate.titanium
majorIds.Juggle: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -8% and -2%, and Finality's damage scaling is halved.

lore: The carving on this archaic piece of armor writes: Ketlednah Icsul
icon.value.name: chestplate.titanium

lore: The carving on this timeworn staff writes: Hisel Acetlrif
icon.value.name: wand.multi3

lore: The power of the unknown. The mysteries hidden in dark corners, between the walls; the forgotten poems, the renounced names, the words spoken into the abyss and never heard again. Meld them, wield them; they are yours to command.
icon.value.name: spear.multi3

lore: I am thou... Thou art I.
icon.value.name: leggings.titanium
majorIds.Altruism: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

lore: There is very little outside the purview of those with power. No matter the circumstance, those in a higher position can, will, and have justified their actions in different ways. Some reasons are fine, some are weak. But what sort of justification is there, for those in the highest position? You have the floor.
icon.value.name: spear.fire3
majorIds.Divine Right: Your Maximum Health is reduced by 75%. For every 100 HP lost, Sacred Surge's damage is increased by 2%.

lore: Archers have often experimented with tipped arrows. Launching the substance itself, however, is an innovation. A viscous ooze corrosive to anything it touches, it remains to be seen if their remains will be seen.
icon.value.name: bow.water3
majorIds.Gunk Shot: Arrow Bomb's velocity is doubled but loses -66% radius and -20% damage.

lore: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.
icon.value.name: relik.water3

lore: Shift after shift, the workers gave everything they had. Quota after quota, even that was not enough. They could only take so much of this before their very spirit was forever broken.
icon.value.name: bracelet.earth2

lore: An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.
icon.value.name: boots.titanium

lore: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.
icon.value.name: bow.fire3

lore: You're the only one left. The only light remaining to lift this world out of endless night. Push on; one day, you may make it.
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium

lore: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.
icon.value.name: wand.multi3
majorIds.Accretion Chain: Chain Lightning hits slower, rebounds, adds 6 chains, and pulls mobs closer for a 9999% explosion spell.

lore: He never dies.
icon.value.name: spear.thunder3

lore: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.
icon.value.name: wand.earth3
majorIds.Fissure: Ice Snake moves much more slowly, but deals massive knockback, +350%, and +200%.

lore: Your wit picked bare, the raw burn of reality exposing your fresh warped self to the world. Your abilities magnified, a new power ripping free from under your skin. You have traded your mind for something far, far greater.
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium

lore: She's taken all you have. Your blood. Your sweat. Your tears. You must repay the debt, no matter the consequences, so that what was stolen will be returned tenfold.
icon.value.name: leggings.titanium

lore: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?
icon.value.name: bow.fire3
majorIds.Napalm: Fire Creep increases Arrow Bomb damage by +15%, but deals 15 times the self-damage and lowers velocity. Scorched Earth radius is increased and deals +65%.

lore: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.
icon.value.name: wand.multi3

lore: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.
icon.value.name: spear.multi3

lore: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.
icon.value.name: bow.thunder3
majorIds.Phase Vector: Shocking Bomb and Arrow Storm become lightning fast with reduced spread.

lore: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.
icon.value.name: wand.thunder3
majorIds.Unstable Reaction: Judrajim no longer ramps in damage after each hit. When it expires, it releases 115% of its potential in an explosion of 20 blocks.

lore: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.
icon.value.name: spear.water3
majorIds.Tidal Drift: Flying Kick will instead send you forwards. This effect is limited to once per Charge cast.

lore: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.
icon.value.name: dagger.water3
majorIds.Enlightenment: 25% chance for spells to cost no mana and instead refund 25% of their original cost.

lore: There is a certain fascination to what lies beyond our grasp, to the spaces we cannot quite see. Harness that pull, draw in your foe, bend it to your will. What could go wrong?
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium

lore: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.
icon.value.name: bow.air3
majorIds.Regicide: You deal 2% more damage for every block you are away from your target (Max 120%).

lore: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.
icon.value.name: relik.thunder3

lore: A gentle, warm glow for the weak, and flames of condemnation for the wicked. Such is the doctrine you follow, and thus, the will you shall enact upon this earth.
icon.value.name: chestplate.titanium

lore: You're seeing double. Perhaps that's because there's more than one reality there.
icon.value.name: ring.thunder2

lore: The depths bring stability, order, security. Those above are weak, unable to withstand the pressure. Those below are concerned with what lies further down. Leave your lawlessness, your chaos, your delusions of freedom. Open yourself to the abyss.
icon.value.name: dagger.water3

lore: There's an inscription written hastily lining the edge of the blade: "Before it is over, I will see you again... but I have been called. And I must answer."
icon.value.name: spear.fire3

lore: Whipping, chilling winds, and circling hailstones the size of boulders-the eye of your storm is the only safe place to be.
icon.value.name: chestplate.titanium
majorIds.Ice Storm: Arrow Shield and Snowstorm's radius' increase by 6 blocks. Arrow Shield's charges are doubled, but no longer give defense.

lore: It was a timeless duel, a clash of titans. Two soldiers so similar, so powerful, yet irrevocably at odds. But in the end, a bent link torn from a coat of mail stands testimony: she stood no chance, the warrior in discord with her own blade.
icon.value.name: ring.earth2
majorIds.Brutal Blow: Armour Breaker now gives an extra +10% damage and has its cooldown reduced by 5s, but lasts half as long.

lore: Empty threats, thrilling bluffs, false promises: a little bravado goes a long way. Wielded properly, diction can be just as fatal as a knife to the heart, and it's much cleaner besides.
icon.value.name: wand.thunder3

lore: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium

lore: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.
icon.value.name: wand.water3
majorIds.Requiem: Sunflare regenerates twice the health and mana.

lore: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.
icon.value.name: bow.air3

lore: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.
icon.value.name: wand.water3

icon.value.name: bow.fire3

lore: The world is a blur around you. The swirls of colour interweave and blend to an amalgam of light in every direction. The worst thing you can do is stop.
icon.value.name: necklace.air2
majorIds.Lasso: Grappling Hook, War Scream, and Uproot now pull enemies with much more force.

lore: Your limbs fail you, and yet you still stand. Something, someone, has invaded your body, and it will use you until your last breath.
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium
majorIds.Explosive Impact: Exploding gives an additional chance to deal 300% Main Attack damage in a radius of 5 blocks upon killing an enemy.

lore: Under the waters, between the waves, there lies something-something beautiful.
icon.value.name: wand.water3
majorIds.Gentle Glow: Orphion's Pulse restores 10% more max health per pulse, but heals at a slower rate.

lore: Allies are exhausting, with their egos and beliefs, and pesky moral codes. Followers are much better-soldiers in your own perfect image, whose deaths are merely scaffolds to a world of your design.
icon.value.name: dagger.earth3
majorIds.Living Museum: Players within 10 blocks of Mirage, Shadow, or Another Self clones will get 20% resistance, and be healed 8%, 15%, or 50% max health when the respective clone is destroyed.

lore: Join the fight.
icon.value.name: leggings.titanium
majorIds.Scarce Comfort: Freestream Flow becomes slightly stronger and lasts indefinitely.

lore: You have seen the worst the world has to offer, and met it with a cold, determined gaze. You kill for those who cannot defend themselves. The battle is everlasting, but you are a durable soldier. Push through; for honour, for glory, for truth.
icon.value.name: chestplate.titanium

lore: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.
icon.value.name: relik.earth3

lore: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.
icon.value.name: dagger.multi3

lore: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.
icon.value.name: spear.fire3
majorIds.Heroine's Blessing: Devout Union gains +25% damage redirection and +8 radius. Additionally, Mantles given by Enlightenment have +20% damage reduction.

lore: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.
icon.value.name: relik.air3
majorIds.Lightweight: You no longer take fall damage.

lore: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."
icon.value.name: relik.fire3
majorIds.Lit Fuse: Friendly Fire now works on Totem as well. When Totem's timer runs out, it explodes, firing 5 beams in all directions, each dealing 500%.

lore: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?
icon.value.name: bow.basicGold
majorIds.River of Souls: Phantom Ray gains massive radius, but reduced damage by 20%.

icon.value.name: dagger.earth3
majorIds.Flurry of Blows: Turn Double Slice into a 10-hit pummeling of 16% damage per hit.

lore: The leaves in this coronet cackle and hiss, a cacophony of malicious intent. They would just as soon shred your enemies to bits as remove your own head from your shoulders.
icon.value.name: helmet.titanium

lore: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.
icon.value.name: spear.multi3
majorIds.Oneself Unto All: Radiance's radius extends 4 blocks beyond Bash and buffs allies with your stats instead of theirs.

lore: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.
icon.value.name: relik.earth3
majorIds.Starcrossed: Haunting Memory links up to 8 enemies together. While linked, enemies take +50% damage from Malediction and share this damage with every other linked enemy.

lore: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.
icon.value.name: bracelet.thunder2
majorIds.Split Second: Aura now travels faster with Invigorating Wave unlocked, but no longer gives mana.

lore: Break free. Free from the constraints of the flesh, free from the constraints of the mind, free from the constraints of the self.
icon.value.name: chestplate.titanium

lore: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.
icon.value.name: bow.water3

lore: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?
icon.value.name: dagger.fire3

lore: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.
icon.value.name: wand.fire3

lore: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.
icon.value.name: bow.fire3
majorIds.Heartbeat: Arrow Shield is set to 2 charges but deals doubled damage. Arrow Wall instead triples Arrow Shield damage and doubles Guardian Angels ammo.

lore: The jewel attached to this pendant glows blood red from the heat contained within, replicating a throbbing, volcanic heartbeat. One's soul is rejuvenated from the embers of your enemies caught in the burning ash of each pulse.
icon.value.name: necklace.fire2

lore: A deep rage settles upon you. An unquenchable fury at the world around you, and all its wretched failings.
icon.value.name: ring.fire2
dagger.earth3

lore: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.
icon.value.name: relik.air3
chestplate.titanium
majorIds.Forest's Blessing: Call of the Hound gains 50% movement speed, attack speed and vision at the cost of a -30% damage penalty on Arrow Bomb.

lore: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.
icon.value.name: wand.multi3

lore: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.
icon.value.name: dagger.fire3
majorIds.Juggle: Mutilate adds an additional 12 hits. All hits are reduced by -8% and -2%, and Finality's damage scaling is halved.

lore: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.
icon.value.name: dagger.air3

lore: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.
icon.value.name: boots.titanium
majorIds.Rock Shield: Arrow Shield's defense is increased by 10%, but its number of charges is reduced by 1.

lore: The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.
